# The RPC contract

<!-- Generated by protocol/generate_docs.py from protocol/*.fbs: do not edit. -->

The RPCs by which the UI, the Web and the Agent talk to `tsugumid`, generated from the doc comments of [protocol/tsugumi.fbs](../protocol/tsugumi.fbs).

- **Format**: one message is one FlatBuffer (root `Tsugumi.RPC.Message`, file identifier `TSG1`). The WebSocket subprotocol is `tsugumi.rpc.v1`; on a Unix socket, a 4-byte length (little endian) is followed by the body.
- **Failure**: any request may be answered with `Failure`.
- **Requests that change something**: carry an `op_id`, and a resend with the same `op_id` is applied only once. If a response is lost, check with `OperationGet`.
- **The Agent's tools**: made from the same schema (`tsugumi.bfbs`) ([Features](features.md#9-agent)).

There are 48 requests.

## Connection

| Request | Response | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`SessionHello`](#sessionhello) | HelloResult | token is required on WebSocket. Project mismatch is permission_denied. Must be the first request, within 5 s of connecting. `protocol` is the newest version the client speaks and `min_protocol` the oldest (default: protocol); the server answers with the newest version both speak (HelloResult.protocol), or protocol_mismatch. |

### SessionHello

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `protocol` | `uint32` |  |  |
| `client_id` | `string` | yes |  |
| `expected_project_id` | `string` |  |  |
| `token` | `string` |  |  |
| `min_protocol` | `uint32` |  |  |
| `language` | `string` |  | The client's language ("ja" or "en"; anything else is Japanese). What tsugumid writes into the project's git for the runs this connection starts (the commit message, the run's note) is in it. |

## Projects and saving

| Request | Response | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`ProjectOpen`](#projectopen) | OpenResult | Creates (or replaces) the connection's subscription. |
| [`ProjectClose`](#projectclose) | Ack | Ends only the given subscription. Unknown ids are acknowledged. |
| [`ProjectInspect`](#projectinspect) | ProjectSnapshot | No subscription, build or reload. |
| [`ProjectSave`](#projectsave) | SaveResult | Apply all changes in one transaction at base_rev. |
| [`ProjectReload`](#projectreload) | SaveResult | Takes external edits of the allowed area into the document. |
| [`ProjectValidate`](#projectvalidate) | ProjectValidateResult | targets = [] means everything; mode = executable. |
| [`ProjectImport`](#projectimport) | ProjectImportResult | definitions = [] imports every definition of the grant. |
| [`ProjectShell`](#projectshell) | ProjectShellResult | Runs in the project VM as the project user, with the project directory as cwd. Available only when the isolated project launcher enables it. timeout_ms defaults to 10000 and must be between 1 and 30000. Each output stream is capped at 262144 bytes. Disconnecting cancels the process group. An operation ID is never executed twice, even after an interrupted daemon. Agent use requires explicit Shell access in addition to Read, Write and Run. After editing project definitions or tsugumi.json with a command, use ProjectReload before inspecting or running the changed project through core. |
| [`ProjectCacheClear`](#projectcacheclear) | ProjectCacheClearResult | Only while no run or SDK job is active. |
| [`ProjectCacheUsage`](#projectcacheusage) |  | Cached shared-store measurement; never triggers a store traversal on the RPC lane. |
| [`LayoutArrange`](#layoutarrange) | LayoutProposal | Places the scope's Cards, output frames and notes, then gives ports the order that crosses fewer wires and places the Cards once more for it. The bars are taken to follow the Cards again. Nothing is saved. |
| [`LayoutUntangle`](#layoutuntangle) | LayoutProposal (port_orders only) | Reorders ports where the wires then cross less; no Card moves. With `around` (the Cards a drag just moved) only they and the Cards wired to them may change. Nothing is saved. |
| [`OperationGet`](#operationget) | OperationResult |  |

## Card SDKs and types

| Request | Response | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`CardSDKPrepare`](#cardsdkprepare) | CardSDKPrepareResult | Accepted asynchronously. |
| [`CardSDKStatus`](#cardsdkstatus) | CardSDKPrepareResult or Failure |  |
| [`OutputTypes`](#outputtypes) | OutputTypesResult | Compiles an _outputs.fbs text (nothing is saved): its reflection schema (bfbs), from which a client lists the types. With port and type_name, also the text with that port's type and kind set (File / Directory: the tsugumi attribute). |
| [`NixSourceResolve`](#nixsourceresolve) | NixSourceResolved | Looks a flake up for nixSources (nothing is saved): its current commit and hash, and the packages it has for this system. To customize an approved package, save nixSources[].overrides = {"packageName":{"override":{"argument":"value"},"overrideAttrs":{"pname":"custom"}}}. Both maps contain JSON values, not Nix functions. A value {"fetchurl":{"url":"https://...","sha256":"..."}} fetches a hash-pinned source or patch in the external evaluator. Modifying these overrides needs user approval. Cards consume inputs.sources.<name>.packages.<packageName>, with the system already selected. Unsupported override/overrideAttrs functions return an actionable evaluation error. Slow the first time: it evaluates them, fetching what they need. |

| [`VersionDiff`](#versiondiff) | VersionDiff: what a version changed from another version (its first parent by default), in the text a summary is written from | Only code and settings: never data files. |
| [`VersionSummary`](#versionsummary) | VersionResult | Keeps a client's summary of a version in the commit's own note (refs/notes/tsugumi-summary), replacing the one there. |

## Host-side services

`tsugumi-agentd` serves two separate FlatBuffers contracts. The Mac app uses the shared C ABI byte client; the Web host uses a Unix socket and generated TypeScript bindings. The browser retains its HTTP/SSE API; the host token never reaches it. `tsugumi-rpc` accepts project RPC only.

| Contract | Root / identifier | WebSocket subprotocol | Principal |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Agent (`agent.fbs`) | `Tsugumi.Agent.Message` / `TSA1` | `tsugumi.agent.v1` | User or external Agent |
| Host (`host.fbs`) | `Tsugumi.Host.Message` / `TSH1` | `tsugumi.host.v1` | User only |

Both use a little-endian uint32 length followed by a buffer on Unix, or one binary buffer per WebSocket message. The Host socket is the Agent socket path plus `.host`; its WebSocket listener uses a separate ephemeral port on the same address. `agent.ready` publishes `unix_socket`, `endpoint`, `host_socket` and `host_endpoint`. It is a private JSON discovery file, not an RPC envelope.

`service_common.fbs` shares Hello, Failure, Acknowledgement and typed Provider configuration. Configure on Host provisions the global provider; Configure on Agent requires a conversation ID. The two roots reject each other's frames. All replies are typed; there is no `Result{json}`.

JSON text is confined to model content (`ModelMessage.content_json`, `provider_content_json`), tool arguments/results (`ToolCallRequest.arguments_json`, `ToolRecord.arguments_json`, `result_json`, `Helper.result_json`, `Event.input_json`) and the open-ended JSON Schema of tool arguments (`Tool.input_schema_json`). Model provider blocks and tool payloads vary by provider/tool; service metadata, usage, permissions, credentials and provider configuration are typed.
